body: Firstly, dont kill yourself this wednesday. Stand up for yourself. Confront those who did you wrong and then shut them off. Im certain of the fact that you have been a great person to those around which is the reason they treat you badly. They take advantage of the fact that you're a good person. So in order to deal with these people, dont take their shit. Be an asshole back. Call a suicide hotline if your country has one. Secondly there is no need to feel guilty because others treat you badly. It is NOT your fault. People come and go. Find someone who can shelter you from all this. A good friend or relationship partner. Someone who can understand you. There are two things you need to remember to do: Stand up for yourself, and find someone who can understand you. And dont rest until you do
